svg.title: The modular kit
svg.desc: Painterly 3/4 studies of every kit piece with W × D × H envelopes in G units and centimetres, grouped by family.
svg.text: Every piece as a 3/4 study in the overview light — low sun upper-left, cool blue-grey shade. Envelopes W × D × H in G (10 cm) and cm; bay 200 cm. Grey figure = 180 cm person.
Concept only · no textures created · P1 / P2 / P3 import order stands
bottom-left grid pivot · 200 cm bay · 320 cm storey (slums 280) · 30 cm wall · framing 20 × 20
every district · rear lanes: smoked oak, stained plaster, puddled setts, moss at bases, few lanterns — fronts stay kept
doors 100 × 210 · windows 90 × 140 within 200 × 320 bays · round arches = civic, library, gates, strongroom
dashed: walls above / below · 1 m = 45 px
50° clay tile · 26 cm courses · envelopes rounded, pitch exact
pale dressed stone · round arches only · lead-grey metal dome
Ø28 drum · lead-grey, never gold · 1 m = 10 px
pointed arches, tracery, pinnacles and rose: nowhere else in town
base-centre pivot · blank sign silhouettes · neutral diamond / chevron banners
assembled from the kit vocabulary · sizes set at assembly
shown on 200 cm swatches · restrained, never baked into base colour
three autumn canopies max · crowns sized before modelling
Dock piece removed (owner decision 2026-11-16). Shading planes are illustration only — base colours stay the palette.json swatches.
